description: Ministry of Development Strategies & International Trade - Order made to extend the time granted to implement the project in relevant to the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1714/3 of 11.07.2011
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order amending a previous order under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008.
